notes.title: Hyper has become an offline app!
notes.content:
Hyper has become an offline app!
Get Hyper Pro DLC and unlock all features.

notes.title: Update for February 12th 2025
notes.content:
More localization options! 

- Chinese (Simplified)
- Chinese (Traditional)
- French
- Indonesian
- Korean
- Spanish
- Thai

notes.title: Updates for January 23rd 2025
notes.content: - Fixes a crash, and contains other minor optimizations and improvements.

notes.title: Update notes for October 8th 2024
notes.content:
- Hyper Desktop now supports blendshape streaming from an iOS device! This is still in beta, and is best on a fast network.
- A number of asset-related bugs has been fixed.
- We've added a brand-new aspect ratio customizer to the Studio. You can now choose Portrait, Landscape, Free, or Square resolutions for your virtual webcam. Be sure to reset the target app so it recognizes the size change when switching aspect ratios.

notes.title: September 3rd 2024 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Skin disappearing? We've added new anti-aliasing settings in App Settings for computers with less VRAM.
[*] Prepares the app for a bunch of new art coming later this week, check back soon!
[*] If some items are missing from your inventory, they should show up with the art changes in a day or two.
[*] Other minor bug fixes, style cleanups, and more.
[/list]

notes.title: Update on August 21st 2024
notes.content:
- Hyper subscriber rewards are now on Desktop!
- A large number of new assets have been added to the builder.
- The builder now has a better filtering system for finding the items you want.

notes.title: Update for August 8th, 2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Outline shaders are now smoother.
[*] Scene images now save even if you delete the source.
[*] Other minor optimizations.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for August 1st 2024
notes.content:
Today's update adds scenes support! Save up to 3 scenes for free, or join Hyper Pro and add unlimited scenes.  We've also:

- Made minor optimizations.
- Fixed an issue with non-english regions missing text.

notes.title: Notes for July 29th 2024
notes.content: Hyper Desktop is no longer invite-only, thank you so much for all your feedback over the last few months. We've been working on hard on building the features you all want, and can't wait to keep building the best vtubing app together. If you have any feedback, or anything you'd like to see, hop over to our community over at https://discordd.gg/hyperonline

notes.title: Updates for July 3rd 2024
notes.content:
Try out the new Hyper recording tools!

- Visit the webcam studio.
- Click the film-strip button next to the virtual webcam button to start recording a clip.

Be sure to leave us feedback and bug reports over at https://discord.gg/hyperonline

notes.title: June 12 2024 Patch
notes.content: Improves the checkout flow and fixes some minor bugs.

notes.title: June 9th Patch
notes.content: Fixes an issue during login that prevents the onboarding section from showing up.

notes.title: Hyper 0.1.11
notes.content: Hyper 0.1.11 is a supplemental hot fix for a bug with the checkout flow introduced in Hyper 0.1.10. This has been fixed. Hyper 0.1.10 added the ability to change the background from the studio, improved user experience changes, and a number of other minor changes and fixes. For feedback during early access, please visit https://discord.gg/hyperonline

notes.title: Hyper 0.1.10
notes.content:
Hyper 0.1.10 adds a Camera Effects button in the Studio Toolbar. Use it to set a custom background or quickly change your Chroma Key. We've also made minor optimizations like improved the smoothing of the tracking wireframe. We also fixed a bug with custom teeth, and added the ability to upload custom profile backgrounds.

Enjoy, and join our discord at https://discord.gg/hyperonline to provide feedback during early access.

notes.title: Update notes for May 29th, 2024
notes.content:
This week's update adds the following improvements:

[list]
[*] Adds a "Face front" mode to the motion capture selector if your camera is off to the side. Just keep in mind it still needs full view of your face to work properly.
[*] Improves performance across various areas of the application.
[*] Fixes an issue where gem counts when buying accessories was calculated wrong.
[*] And a number of other smaller optimizations.
[/list]
Read the changelog here: https://blog.hyper.online/blog/new-in-hyper-desktop-v0-1-9
